title: Email: Fw: One thing for us to discuss ...

content.subject: Fw: One thing for us to discuss ...

content.text:
Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Sent: Friday, January 4, 2019 3:54 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: One thing for us to discuss ... 
 
Whenever we meet: Video views.
Have to find a way to give those a boost next season. In the pecking order of our beat writers, you ranked sixth by about 1.5M.
Just want to see what options we have, and I didn’t want to forget about it in the meantime.
